raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to adapt its strategy after the WebSurfer encountered repeated technical failures (TimeoutErrors) when trying to access authoritative sources like IMDb and Wikipedia. Instead of switching to a different agent (e.g., Coder to write a script to fetch data) or concluding the task based on the initial search results which were sufficient to identify the film, the Planner continued to instruct the WebSurfer to perform the exact same actions (visit IMDb/Wikipedia) in subsequent steps. This led to a repetitive loop of errors without resolving the underlying issue or finding an alternative path to the solution.
